title: Kernel exposes BTF at /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux
question: Does this kernel ship BTF type information, the baseline for CO-RE and for typed probes?
pass_means: BTF is present and readable, so CO-RE relocation and fentry-style typed attachment are possible in principle.
fail_means: The kernel was built without CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF. CO-RE programs need an external BTF source here.
